guardrails: Use only on a trusted LAN.
Do not expose this server to the public internet without authentication, firewall, and reverse-proxy review.
Do not store device passwords, Wi-Fi credentials, browser cookies, or tokens in this repository.
Keep remote device communication read-only until an authenticated write channel is explicitly implemented.
next_verification: Find Aria PC LAN IP with ipconfig.
Run tools/aria_device_mesh_probe.ps1 -BaseUrl http://<aria-pc-lan-ip>:8787 -RecordPath reports/device_mesh_lan_receipt.json after remote checks are reachable.
